build_dir.description: Path to the build directory containing plan.json.

milestone_id.description: Id of the single milestone to verify. Every step in it must be `documented`. Must match the `M<n>` form (e.g. M2) that agents/_shared/schemas/build-plan.schema.json requires.

approver_name.description: Optional human name, used only to render the build_plan.py gate command line.
